evidence.quote: (b) The patient’s family income does not exceed 400% of the FPL; and
A patient who satisfies all the following criteria shall receive a 100% charity discount on all Eligible Hospital Services provided by Washington Hospital:
Patient can reapply for charity care or financial assistance at any time.

presumptive_eligibility: Patients recognized as homeless and deceased patients with no estate may be deemed eligible without meeting documentation requirements.
how_to_apply: Complete the Application for Financial Assistance; contact the Financial Assistance Coordinator at (510) 818-7448.
warnings: Eligibility requires Self-Pay Patient or High Medical Cost Patient status (insured patients qualify only as High Medical Cost Patients).
Policy states no explicit application deadline; no effective date given.
A separate Cash Discount Policy for Uninsured and Underinsured Patients exists with its own discounts, not detailed here.
Policy excludes non-medically necessary services and separately-billed physician services.
Policy says nothing about assets or residency.
